protocol.paint: System ScreenCaptureKit window-only recording, requested 60 Hz; AVFoundation PTS on mach host clock. Vision revision 1 accurate CPU offline identifies target document text (including visible frontmatter) in preview ROI; first frames visually checked. UI automation only prepares/closes windows, never starts/stops the stopwatch.
protocol.warm: Fresh app process with a tiny baseline visibly ready, then dispatch another file through /usr/bin/open (official obsidian URI for its isolated vault). Native document/tab behavior and default viewport retained. MDVu dedicated empty SVG cache per prepared process.
protocol.launch: App stopped, prepared profile; common-test-light. Process birth to first readable content. OS disk caches not flushed, not installation/first-ever launch. VS Code official CLI opens prepared preview workspace; Typora trial reminder prevents a comparable result.
protocol.diagram: Unchanged tests/fixtures/runtime/mermaid-only.md, two nodes; require both SVG labels Input and Output as exact OCR text, visually check diagram. Includes engine startup/scheduling; not layout throughput or full-catalogue completion.
protocol.memory: 200 ms proc_pid_rusage physical footprint; sum app, descendants and newly started WebKit XPC services after isolated session baseline. Median of samples 7–8 seconds after actual dispatch, peak over 0–8 seconds. Profiles excluded from installed size; renderer/helper memory included. Shared services are not perfectly attributable; sums may count shared pages. Background OS memory not included.
protocol.limitations: One observation per selected app/input, no statistical confidence or p95. Different default native window sizes and editor/preview layouts recorded, tiny baseline may remain as an extra window/tab. Common-content derivatives remove diagram fences only; they still contain HTML/math/frontmatter. First readable content does not mean every asset/diagram finished or controls responsive. Typora/MarkViewer live editors and MacDown preview expose source in the first viewport of onescreen, not a timed formatted render. Long-running heavy cases get 30-second videos; RAM peaks still use the same first 8 seconds. No universal fastest/lowest-memory claim, and no Windows competitor performance claim. MDVu light and first Mermaid were repeated three times in a later paired session; its representative cell is the median trial. Other applications retain the earlier observations in this prepared-profile table.
